subject.title: feat(plugins): add Control UI entry points

question: Should OpenClaw accept this plugin Control UI entry-point API now, and if yes must entry pages be restricted to in-app opaque iframes with fail-closed launch tokens?
rationale: The patch creates a permanent public plugin UI API across the authenticated Control UI, Gateway auth, and browser sandbox boundary; automation cannot choose the long-term trust model.

options.title: Require sandboxed entry API first
options.body: Keep this PR open but require in-app opaque iframe rendering, fail-closed launch errors, refreshed exact-head proof, and then maintainer API review.

options.title: Approve broader launch modes
options.body: Maintain the same-window/new-window contract only after maintainers explicitly accept the security model and add targeted browser/security proof.

options.title: Pause for the RFC
options.body: Close or pause this branch and resolve the native plugin page and broader contribution-slot API direction in the canonical design issues first.

recommendation.title: Require sandboxed entry API first
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open but require in-app opaque iframe rendering, fail-closed launch errors, refreshed exact-head proof, and then maintainer API review.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged and reviewed the host-hook foundation this public plugin UI API extends, making them the best routing owner from the available history.
